unit correction: the supplied key selects B, lumens, which measure luminous flux. Luminous intensity is measured in candela; irradiance/radiant intensity use other units. No option unambiguously states the requested intensity unit. Accept a correct explanation and retain manual marking.

the source key A overgeneralises density. The table supplies no densities, and sound speed depends on stiffness/compressibility as well as density; wood can transmit sound faster than denser water. The table supports faster sound in the listed solids and warmer air, but no universally valid density rule. Retain manual marking.

frequency × wavelength equals wave speed. C applies to sound waves, but the stem does not specify sound; the surrounding paper also discusses light. Accept C with the sound context or a correct general wave-speed response. Source typo “Speed of money” retained. Manual marking.

source option A contradicts itself by saying all visible light is absorbed while green is reflected. A green object under white light reflects green wavelengths and absorbs much of the other visible light. Accept the intended A with that correction, or a correct explanation rejecting the wording. Manual marking.
